label: Chinese
html:
排版的细节

好的中文排版，讲究的是节奏与留白。标点不能出现在行首，句末的句号和逗号可以悬挂在行外，让每一行的右边缘保持整齐。使用 CSS 3 与 HTML 5，这些规则都由浏览器完成，无需任何脚本。

「设计不只是外观和感觉，设计是它如何运作。」

label: Columns
html:
A printed column is a measure of even grey. Two columns halve the measure and keep a line within the sixty to seventy characters a reader takes in at a glance.

The column property takes a count and a minimum width; when the page grows too narrow for two columns of that width, the block sets one, and a phone reads a single column.

Across both columns

Below the span

A heading or a figure with .typeset-span crosses both columns. The text after it fills two new columns, and the first block starts at the top of the left one, level with the right.

Without that, a subheading's top margin would push the left column below the right: across a column break the margin cannot collapse into the spanner's.

label: Columns in a sans and a monospace face
html:
In the sans

A technical note reads well in the theme's sans face: justified, indented, the same rules as the book page without the serif's formality.

The second paragraph follows with its indent, as in any typeset block.

In the monospace

A monospace column suits commentary beside code: every character the same width, figures lining, the justification spreading only the spaces.

Hyphenation is manual here - monospace words break badly at syllables.

label: Blocksatz (justified)
html:
How the compositor justified a line of movable type by hand

The compositor justified each line by adding space between words and, where the space grew too wide, broke a word at a syllable. Typographically, interdisciplinary and internationalization break where the language allows them to.

label: Einzug (indent)
html:
Einzug

A book keeps the column whole and marks a new paragraph by its indent alone.

The second paragraph steps in by one em; there is no blank line between the two.

Nor between the second and the third.

label: Initiale: drop
html: Printing is the art of multiplying writing by movable type. The first letter of a chapter was once painted by hand into a space the printer left free; a drop initial keeps that space, three lines deep.

label: Initiale: raised
html: Raised: the initial stands on the first baseline and rises above the line, a lighter opening than the drop, used where the column starts high on the page.

label: Opening line: small capitals or capitals
html:
Small capitals carry the opening line at the height of the lowercase, so the chapter begins quietly and the eye slides into the text.

Letterspaced capitals give the opening line more weight - the classic Versalien opening of a title page or a chapter.

label: Classic ligatures and old-style figures
html: The fine office of the compositor, strict in its rules, reached Mainz in 1450 and Venice by 1469.

label: Leading: tight, normal, loose
html:
Tight leading closes the lines up and the tracking closes a little with it: a dense column for notes, tables of contents and long reference lists.

The default leading suits continuous reading: one line flows into the next without the eye losing its place at the start of the line.

Loose leading opens the lines and the tracking opens with them: an airy setting for introductions, abstracts and short pieces.

label: Separators
html:
A short rule, centred:

An asterism, the oldest mark of a section break:

⁂

A dinkus, three spaced asterisks:

* * *

A fleuron, the printer's flower:

❦

An ornament, the glyph between two lines:

◆

And the text resumes.

label: Page, column, left and right page breaks
html:
Imposition

The compositor fills the left column with the opening of the chapter and ends it where the argument turns.

The right column opens with the turn, whatever room the left one left.

A new page

The next section starts a page of its own.

A new chapter

A chapter opens on a right-hand page; a blank page is added when the last one ended on the right.

label: Keeps, splits, orphans and widows
html:
Paper sizes

A sheet folded once makes a folio, twice a quarto, three times an octavo - the table below lists the leaves.

Three lines of a paragraph stay at the foot of a column and three move to the head of the next, or the paragraph moves whole.

The night shift

The overseer kept a log of every forme locked up and every sheet pulled. One night of it runs longer than a column.

By three in the morning both sheets were dry enough to fold, and the formes were back in the cases.

label: Book page
html:
Of the Art of Printing

Printing is the art of multiplying writing by movable type. The compositor takes each letter from the case, sets it in the stick, justifies the line with spaces of different widths and locks the finished forme before a single sheet is pulled - a craft that reached Mainz in 1450 and Venice by 1469.

Each following paragraph runs on without a gap; only its first line steps in by one em. The column therefore reads as one even grey, and the eye finds the start of a thought by the indent alone.

A justified column hyphenates its longer words - typographical, interdisciplinary, internationalization - so that the spaces between words stay close to one width, and its last line stays flush to the start.

label: Book page without an initial
html:
Of the Art of Printing

Printing is the art of multiplying writing by movable type. The compositor takes each letter from the case, sets it in the stick and justifies the line with spaces of different widths before a single sheet is pulled.

Each following paragraph runs on without a gap; only its first line steps in by one em, and the opening line in small capitals marks the start without a large letter.
